answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a kernel for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to lock capital to validate network operations. An attacker attempting to flood the system must acquire a glacier-sized majority of assets, a task as difficult as carving a marble statue from dust. This economic threshold ensures that creating fake identities costs exponentially more than the marginal utility gained from malicious influence, forcing adversaries to weigh the prohibitive expense against any potential gain.
